problem: Manually engineered static prompts are costly and inflexible for complex reasoning across diverse tasks.
assumption_broken: Reasoning prompts can evolve collaboratively instead of remaining manually fixed or requiring model fine-tuning.
operational_signature: Initialize candidates → rank leaders → guide followers → iterate refinements
load_bearing_mechanism: A Grey Wolf Optimizer leader-follower hierarchy lets the three strongest agents guide population-level prompt evolution.
title: Agent-GWO: Collaborative Agents for Dynamic Prompt Optimization in Large Language Models

problem: Dataset verification pipelines are static, domain-specific, and dependent on expensive human expertise.
assumption_broken: Verification workflows can be synthesized from natural-language requests rather than hard-coded for each schema.
operational_signature: Interpret request → decompose dependencies → reuse or synthesize functions → execute checks
load_bearing_mechanism: A planner generates DAG workflows whose modular agents combine reusable tools with synthesized verification functions.
title: SpeechQC-Agent: A Natural Language Driven Multi-Agent System for Speech Dataset Quality

problem: Ambiguous and underspecified image-generation prompts cause unstable outputs that deviate from user intent.
assumption_broken: Prompt-image alignment alone is insufficient to characterize the stability of user-to-model communication.
operational_signature: Read input → enhance information → align entities → generate output
load_bearing_mechanism: NoxEye combines a model-distribution information enhancer with fine-grained visual-entity alignment to optimize prompts.
title: Auth-Prompt Bench: Towards Reliable and Stable Prompting in Text-to-Image Generation

problem: Manually collected training trajectories are costly, while directly proposed tasks may be infeasible or already mastered.
assumption_broken: An agent can discover feasible training behaviors through exploration before proposing what another agent should learn.
operational_signature: Explore environment → construct feasible examples → train learner → diagnose gaps → redirect exploration
load_bearing_mechanism: An exploration agent grounds skill data in actual environment interactions and redirects subsequent exploration using learner-performance feedback.
title: Toward Self-Evolving Systems of LLM Agents through Exploration and Iterative Feedback

problem: Unstructured prompt optimization is computationally expensive and can distort original intent.
assumption_broken: Prompt optimization can change segment-level importance annotations rather than rewriting the entire prompt.
operational_signature: Segment input → assign importance annotations → optimize annotations → generate response
load_bearing_mechanism: Human-readable importance annotations on interpretable prompt segments steer attention while preserving the underlying text.
title: Prompt Segmentation and Annotation Optimisation: Controlling LLM Behaviour via Optimised Segment-Level Annotations

problem: Decoupled exploration and distillation fail to exploit complementary strengths of large and small web agents.
assumption_broken: A distilled smaller model can contribute novel exploration rather than serving only as a passive student.
operational_signature: Generate demonstrations → distill learner → explore divergent actions → enrich demonstrations → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Student action divergence feeds new trajectories back into coupled data synthesis and distillation, supported by speculative synthesis and multi-task learning.
title: Symbiotic Cooperation for Web Agents: Harnessing Complementary Strengths of Large and Small LLMs

problem: Static jailbreak templates and inefficient refinement limit attack diversity and effectiveness.
assumption_broken: Attack generation can reuse compressed experiential insights rather than repeatedly searching from static templates.
operational_signature: Generate varied seeds → evaluate attempts → compress successful patterns → retrieve insights → refine candidates
load_bearing_mechanism: Short- and long-term experience pools compress successful attack patterns into reusable meta-instructions for subsequent refinement.
title: ExpeAttack: Efficient and Diverse LLM Jailbreaking via Two-Stage Exploration with Experience Replay

problem: Fixed knowledge and reasoning prevent navigation agents from effectively incorporating experience during testing.
assumption_broken: A frozen-model navigation agent can continually improve at test time by accumulating and reflecting on experience.
operational_signature: Record outcomes → abstract experience → retrieve knowledge → reason over actions → reflect
load_bearing_mechanism: Hierarchical memory turns both success and failure cases into reusable knowledge for retrieval-augmented reasoning and reflection.
title: SE-VLN: A Self-Evolving Vision-Language Navigation Framework Based on Multimodal Large Language Models

problem: Effective prompt construction lacks systematic guidance from the structural properties of real prompt datasets.
assumption_broken: Prompt syntax can supply an optimization target rather than treating prompts only as arbitrary natural-language instructions.
operational_signature: Collect examples → embed syntax → identify centroid → rewrite toward centroid
load_bearing_mechanism: LLMs rewrite prompts toward a centroid in part-of-speech and dependency-structure embedding space.
title: Large Language Model Prompt Datasets: An In-depth Analysis and Insights

problem: Regulating model safety and coherence through fine-tuning is costly and complex.
assumption_broken: Output behavior can be regulated through external adaptive prompts without retraining or accessing the controlled model internals.
operational_signature: Observe output → evaluate objectives → choose prompt action → update control policy → regulate output
load_bearing_mechanism: A Deep Q-Network selects dynamic prompt actions using a multi-objective reward balancing safety and coherence.

improver_modified.how: The RL-enhanced prompt controller learns a Deep Q-Network policy for prompt actions using multi-objective rewards.

title: In-Context Prompt Optimisation for Knowledge Editing: Enhancing Safety and Coherency in Large Language Models

problem: Workflow design scales poorly and existing optimizers underuse historical context and agent-tool interactions.
assumption_broken: Multi-agent workflow design can be optimized as a heterogeneous adjacency matrix rather than delegated to a meta-agent planner.
operational_signature: Represent components → sample subgraphs → train connectivity → assemble workflow
load_bearing_mechanism: Two-stage matrix training with subgraph sampling optimizes heterogeneous connections among agents, tools, and reasoning steps.
title: A Heterogeneous Graph Optimization Perspective for Multi-Agent System Workflows

problem: Image-generation prompts inadequately express user-specified attributes even when model comprehension or prompt strength improves.
assumption_broken: Natural-language prompt content itself can be optimized as a zero-order search space.
operational_signature: Expand candidates → assess attributes → contrast strong and weak candidates → update guidance → evolve prompts
load_bearing_mechanism: Dynamic contrastive guidance from high- versus low-quality prompt semantics steers heuristic population search toward intended attributes.
title: Dynamic Prompt Evolution via Multi-Attribute Feedback for Text-to-Image Generation

problem: Existing agent protocols limit context management, environmental adaptability, and dynamic agent architectures.
assumption_broken: Environments and agents can be first-class resources while tools can be dynamically created and reused.
operational_signature: Decompose objective → coordinate specialists → retrieve or create tools → execute subtasks
load_bearing_mechanism: The TEA resource protocol supports hierarchical coordination and a tool-manager agent that dynamically creates, retrieves, and reuses tools.
title: AgentOrchestra: Orchestrating Hierarchical Multi-Agent Intelligence with the Tool-Environment-Agent (TEA) Protocol

problem: Iterative textual-gradient optimization becomes unstable through noisy correct-example feedback and overspecialization.
assumption_broken: Textual gradients need not use all examples, and a proposed update should not be accepted merely because it addresses targeted errors.
operational_signature: Identify errors → derive critiques → propose rewrite → test preservation → accept guarded update
load_bearing_mechanism: Error-only textual gradients are combined with a fixed general-example preservation test that gates prompt updates.
title: Pick Your Textual Gradients

problem: Single-model or single-algorithm automatic prompt optimizers have limited performance on complex tasks.
assumption_broken: Prompt optimization need not rely on one generation strategy or search method.
operational_signature: Share generation strategies → explore with multiple searches → vote across proposals → choose prompts
load_bearing_mechanism: Ensemble voting combines shared prompt-generation strategies with different search methods.
title: ELPO: Ensemble Learning Based Prompt Optimization for Large Language Models

problem: Fixed exemplars and neglected relational structure can yield confident but faulty reasoning paths.
assumption_broken: Reasoning exemplars can be dynamically chosen for uncertainty and expected value rather than fixed by humans.
operational_signature: Estimate uncertainty → select examples → extract relations → scaffold reasoning → generate answer
load_bearing_mechanism: Bayesian active exemplar selection is coupled with entity-relation scaffolds to guide coherent reasoning.
title: SDA-CoT: Structure-driven Dynamic Active Chain-of-Thought

problem: Past-interaction retrieval misses critical user information and introduces noise during long-horizon personalized interactions.
assumption_broken: Memory should actively maintain user profiles rather than rely only on semantic grouping of past interactions.
operational_signature: Observe interactions → extract attributes and events → update profile → retrieve hierarchical context → personalize responses
load_bearing_mechanism: Active user-profile updates and hierarchical retrieval of persona attributes and topical context preserve critical personalized information.
title: O-Mem: Omni Memory System for Personalized, Long Horizon, Self-Evolving Agents

problem: Customer-service agents forget between sessions and repeat errors, undermining consistent performance.
assumption_broken: Frozen agents can improve long-term reliability through reusable verbal reflections without parameter fine-tuning.
operational_signature: Observe interactions → distill strategy reflections → store shared memory → retrieve guidance → act
load_bearing_mechanism: Compact strategy reflections distilled from multi-turn interactions are stored and retrieved from a shared memory bank.
title: MemOrb: A Plug-and-Play Verbal-Reinforcement Memory Layer for E-Commerce Customer Service

problem: Direct attempts at complex long-horizon decision tasks fail without progressive skill acquisition.
assumption_broken: Task difficulty can be generated adaptively alongside solutions rather than fixed or increased without a solved-level floor.
operational_signature: Propose task → validate feasibility → generate solution → score shared reward → preserve difficulty floor → advance curriculum
load_bearing_mechanism: A cooperative designer-solver curriculum uses an accepted-floor constraint to prevent regression below previously solved difficulty levels.
title: EvoCurr: Self-evolving Curriculum with Behavior Code Generation for Complex Decision-making

problem: Application updates break UI grounding and alter task logic, making mobile agents unreliable.
assumption_broken: UI representations and procedural task knowledge can evolve separately rather than remaining tied to a fixed application version.
operational_signature: Store interface representations → ground actions → track workflow changes → adapt procedures
load_bearing_mechanism: Dual-level stationary and procedural memory separately support robust multimodal UI grounding and adaptation to workflow changes.
title: Towards Adaptive GUI Agents with Memory-Driven Knowledge Evolution

problem: Diffusion models lose object-count precision under changes in labels, count distributions, and visual domains.
assumption_broken: Distribution-shift robustness can be obtained by adapting structured prompts without retraining the image generator.
operational_signature: Identify shift → adapt prompt components → enforce consistency → calibrate across shifts
load_bearing_mechanism: Hierarchical prompt refinement first adapts to individual shift types and then calibrates cross-shift behavior using text-image consistency guidance.
title: QuantiShift: Any-Shift Object Quantification by Text-to-Image Diffusion Models

problem: Monolithic sequential models struggle to integrate multimodal evidence and resolve competing clinical hypotheses.
assumption_broken: Expert reasoning can be distributed across parallel specialists and adversarial deliberation rather than performed by a single model.
operational_signature: Synthesize evidence in parallel → deliberate over hypotheses → refine decisions → reflect on reasoning traces
load_bearing_mechanism: Parallel evidence synthesis and adversarial collaborative deliberation are augmented with experiential reflection on historical reasoning traces.
title: TCMAgent: A Multi-Agent Framework for General Traditional Chinese Medicine

problem: Static safety benchmarks fail to keep pace with changing model vulnerabilities and regulations.
assumption_broken: Safety evaluation can continually evolve from model results rather than remain a fixed one-time audit.
operational_signature: Parse policies → generate tests → evaluate responses → analyze results → harden tests
load_bearing_mechanism: Specialized agents use evaluation results to iteratively generate more targeted and sophisticated policy-grounded safety test cases.
title: SafeEvalAgent: Toward Agentic and Self-Evolving Safety Evaluation of LLMs

problem: Query-focused table summarization is limited by fine-tuning costs, context limits, privacy exposure, and brittle manual pipelines.
assumption_broken: Summaries need not send table contents to an LLM for every request because executable templates can be generated offline.
operational_signature: Read schema → generate query and template → execute query locally → render summary → reuse across tables
load_bearing_mechanism: Schema-only offline generation produces reusable SQL and Jinja2 templates that summarize tables without exposing their contents to the LLM.
limitations_evident: Template reuse requires tables sharing the same schema.
title: FACTS: Table Summarization via Offline Template Generation with Agentic Workflows

problem: Existing agent memory systems lack adaptability and neglect constructive, task-oriented memory organization.
assumption_broken: Memory can construct and evolve schemas rather than serve only as a passive retrieval store.
operational_signature: Organize schemas → update or evolve or create schemas → combine symbolic and neural access → retrieve relevant memory
load_bearing_mechanism: Trimodal schema adaptation preserves coherent memory organization while hybrid symbolic-neural access improves retrieval.
title: PISA: A Pragmatic Psych-Inspired Unified Memory System for Enhanced AI Agency
